mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.25%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 5.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0% YoY, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 per month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 200,000, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 for two consecutive months, it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of robust GDP growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth above 3.0%), consumer and business confidence is high, leading to strong corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 quarterly growth exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates a monetary policy response to inflation, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
